players.name: Justin Herbert
players.note: Sleeper still listed him questionable with a concussion on Nov. 25, and he must clear every step of the protocol before he can face New England on Nov. 29. DJ Uiagalelei would start if he can't play.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: He remains out with the fibula fracture he suffered Nov. 15, with no surgery planned but no timeline either; Tommy DeVito starts Week 12 vs. the Chargers.

players.name: Tommy DeVito
players.note: He is New England's starter for the Nov. 29 game vs. the Chargers while Drake Maye (fibula) is out, and Sleeper's depth chart has him at QB1.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: He came off Sleeper's injury report early on Nov. 26 and is set to return as Seattle's starter vs. the 49ers on Nov. 29, per Mike Macdonald's Nov. 23 comments.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: Sam Darnold is expected back as the starter on Nov. 29 vs. San Francisco, which sends Lock back to the bench. Sleeper also lists Lock questionable with an elbow injury.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He is still questionable with a Grade 2 hamstring strain as of Nov. 25 as Minnesota targets the Nov. 29 game vs. Atlanta. Sleeper's depth chart has Kirk Cousins as QB1 and Murray third.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart still has him as Minnesota's QB1 as of Nov. 25, but a return by Kyler Murray (questionable, hamstring) on Nov. 29 vs. Atlanta would send him back to the bench.

players.name: Mason Rudolph
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart listed him as Pittsburgh's starting QB as of Nov. 25, with Will Howard second and Drew Allar third.

players.name: Brock Purdy
players.note: Sleeper listed him questionable with an ankle injury on Nov. 25, ahead of the Nov. 29 game vs. Seattle. Watch the rest of the week's practice reports.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Sleeper listed him questionable with back spasms as of Nov. 25; he is still Arizona's QB1 on the depth chart.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: He is still a free agent after Indianapolis released him Nov. 20, and no signing had been reported as of Nov. 26.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after surgery on his right thumb, with a reported 6-9 week timeline. Jacoby Brissett is starting.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: He remains Baltimore's starter with Lamar Jackson (thumb) on IR. He threw for 276 yards, 1 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR (calf) and is expected to miss the rest of 2026. Joe Milton starts for Philadelphia on Thanksgiving at Dallas.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: He remains the Eagles' starter with Jalen Hurts on IR and starts the Thanksgiving game at Dallas on Nov. 26, but he managed only 141 yards and 0 TD on Nov. 22.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR after meniscus surgery on his knee and is expected to miss the rest of the regular season.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: He is starting for the Giants with Jaxson Dart on IR, but he had only 173 passing yards on Nov. 22, and Jameis Winston is taking the goal-line snaps.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: He is on IR (groin) with an estimated return of Dec. 13, and surgery isn't expected. He should reclaim the job from Kyle McCord when healthy.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.note: He is starting only while Malik Willis is on IR (estimated return Dec. 13), and he threw for just 102 yards with 0 TD on Nov. 22.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Corum dominated the Rams' backfield in Wednesday's Nov. 25 game vs. Green Bay with 32 carries for 184 yards and a TD plus 2 catches for 21 yards, while Kyren Williams had 12 carries.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Williams played Nov. 25 vs. Green Bay but was out-carried 32 to 12 by Blake Corum; he still scored a TD and finished with 46 rushing yards and 4 catches for 19 yards. His lead-back status is now in question.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Jacobs (finger, post-surgery) was out for Wednesday's Nov. 25 game at the Rams. Kaleb Johnson started and managed only 21 total yards, so Jacobs should reclaim the lead role once healthy for Week 13.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: With Josh Jacobs (finger) out on Nov. 25 at the Rams, Johnson managed just 8 carries for 13 yards and 1 catch for 19 yards, while Chris Brooks caught 4 passes. He did little to keep the job once Jacobs returns.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Walker (groin) is listed out for Thursday's Thanksgiving game at Buffalo as of Nov. 25, after Andy Reid had said he wouldn't see a ton of work even if active.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: With Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled out for Thursday's Thanksgiving game at Buffalo, Johnson should handle the bulk of Kansas City's backfield after 23 carries for 105 yards and a TD in Week 11.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Henry is still listed questionable with a concussion as of Nov. 25, ahead of Sunday's Week 12 game vs. Houston. Watch the rest of the week's practice reports.

players.name: Justice Hill
players.note: Hill has 23 targets over Baltimore's last four games, and Derrick Henry is listed questionable (concussion) as of Nov. 25 for Sunday vs. Houston. If Henry sits, Hill would take on a larger share of the work.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks (concussion) remains questionable on Sleeper as of Nov. 25. Nov. 24 reports had him trending toward playing Sunday vs. Baltimore, but he still has to clear the protocol.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery had 26 carries for 107 yards in his Week 11 return. Woody Marks (concussion, questionable) could cut into his workload if he clears the protocol before Sunday's game vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Tuten (ankle) is still listed questionable as of Nov. 25 ahead of Sunday's game vs. Tennessee. Liam Coen called the re-aggravation 'not too bad' on Nov. 23, but Jacksonville may be cautious.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Rodriguez would lead the Jaguars' backfield vs. Tennessee on Sunday if Bhayshul Tuten (ankle, questionable as of Nov. 25) sits.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Denver suspended Dobbins for one game on Nov. 24 for conduct reasons, so he'll miss Week 12 vs. Pittsburgh. He had already lost the lead role to Jonah Coleman.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman is Denver's clear lead back after 24 carries for 111 yards and 3 TDs on Nov. 22, and J.K. Dobbins is suspended for Week 12 (announced Nov. 24).

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) remains on IR as of Nov. 25. A Nov. 23 update said Week 13 is the earliest he could be activated.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Croskey-Merritt was activated from IR on Nov. 23 and led Washington's backfield that night with 13 carries for 54 yards and a TD plus 2 catches for 23 yards.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: White was active Nov. 23 vs. Cincinnati but had no carries or catches after Jacory Croskey-Merritt returned from IR.

players.name: Chase Brown
players.note: Brown had just 6 carries for 6 yards and 5 catches for 30 yards on Nov. 23, while Samaje Perine was more productive, which raises the risk of a committee.

players.name: Samaje Perine
players.note: Perine out-produced Chase Brown on Nov. 23 with 6 carries for 26 yards and 4 catches for 71 yards on roughly half the snaps.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Sampson has out-snapped Quinshon Judkins in three straight games, so Cleveland's backfield is now a 50-50 committee. Raheim Sanders was activated from IR on Nov. 24.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Dylan Sampson has out-snapped Judkins in three straight games, so Cleveland's backfield is roughly a 50-50 committee and Judkins' weekly ceiling is lower.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: With Tyjae Spears on IR since Nov. 21, Pollard had 21 carries for 110 yards in Week 11 and is set for a heavy workload vs. Jacksonville.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara played 8 of 72 snaps on Nov. 22 with 1 carry, while Travis Etienne Jr. took 14 carries. He has been reduced to a change-of-pace role.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Etienne led New Orleans with 14 carries for 76 yards on Nov. 22, while Alvin Kamara got 1 carry, making him the Saints' early-down back.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.note: Hampton has handled 65% and 47% of the Chargers' carries the last two weeks. Keaton Mitchell (knee/back) is uncertain for Week 12 vs. New England, which could push more work to Hampton.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Gordon leads Miami's backfield with De'Von Achane out for the season (ACL), and Jaylen Wright aggravated an injury, which leaves Kaytron Allen as the main other back.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.note: Higbee left the Rams' 26-13 Wednesday-night win over the Packers on Nov 25 with a chest injury and did not return. He had 1 catch for 14 yards on 3 targets, and the team has given no recovery timetable.

players.name: Max Klare
players.note: In the Nov 25 win over the Packers, Tyler Higbee (chest) and Davis Allen (ankle) both left with injuries, and Terrance Ferguson is out for the season. That leaves Klare and Colby Parkinson as the healthy Rams tight ends, so his role should grow if Higbee or Allen misses time.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson remains on IR and was ruled out for the Nov 25 game against the Packers. Sean McVay said on Nov 23 that he needs season-ending ankle surgery.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers (ankle) was limited at the Raiders' first Week 12 practice on Wednesday and is no longer listed with the quad injury. Coach Klint Kubiak is optimistic he plays after he missed Week 11.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.note: Johnson (hamstring/wrist) was the only Saints player absent from Wednesday's Week 12 practice. In Week 11 he played only 27 of 72 snaps.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.note: Likely (groin) was limited at the Giants' Wednesday Week 12 practice and is listed questionable.

players.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Fannin (groin) was limited at Wednesday's Week 12 practice and is listed questionable, but reports do not consider his availability in serious doubt.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Kincaid (thumb) is questionable for the Bills' Thanksgiving game against the Chiefs on Nov 26. He was limited on the Monday and Tuesday estimated reports and is considered likely to play after missing Week 11.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Drake Maye (fractured fibula) is out long-term, so Tommy DeVito starts at QB for the Patriots. That lowers Henry's weekly ceiling.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson caught 6 of 7 targets for 55 yards in his Week 11 return on Nov 22. With Jordan Addison out after thumb surgery, his targets should stay strong as his snaps ramp up.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: After a Nov 25 workout that Dan Quinn said went well, Washington signed him to its practice squad. He reunites with Jayden Daniels, but he must be elevated or signed to the 53-man roster to play, the team has given no timeline, and he has not played since his October 2024 ACL/MCL tear.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: He caught 4 passes for 65 yards and a 6-yard TD (his 8th of the season) in the Nov 25 loss to the Rams, then suffered a confirmed concussion on a helmet-to-helmet hit late in the first half. He is now in the concussion protocol ahead of Week 13.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: He did not practice Nov 25 (hamstring), and Mike Vrabel told WEEI he would not expect Brown to play Week 12 at the Chargers. Reports say he is expected to miss multiple weeks, including Week 13 vs. Buffalo.

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.note: He was limited at practice Nov 25 with an ankle injury from Week 10, the first time a health issue (not rest) has cut his reps this season. Friday's report will show whether he carries a designation for Week 12 at San Francisco.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: He was limited again at practice Nov 25 with the ankle injury he has played through for weeks. He is questionable for Week 12.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: He did not practice Nov 25 because of a new quad injury, on top of other lower-body issues he has been playing through. His Week 12 status is in question.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) did not practice Nov 25 and is day-to-day; he likely needs a full practice by Friday to play at Miami. That keeps Mitchell in line for another week as the Jets' WR2.

players.name: Jack Bech
players.note: He set career highs with 8 catches for 88 yards in Week 11 with Brock Bowers out. But Bowers (ankle) was limited at practice Nov 25 and the Raiders are optimistic he plays Week 12 at Cleveland, which would shrink Bech's share of targets.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: He remains on IR (heel) and is listed out for Week 12, but he said this week that he has made progress and hopes to return before the season ends. On Nov 11, Shane Steichen had been unsure whether Pierce would play again in 2026.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison (thumb, post-surgery) is listed doubtful for Week 12 on Sleeper as of Nov 25 after missing Week 11. Tai Felton has been absorbing his targets.

players.name: Konata Mumpfield
players.note: Mumpfield caught 4 of 5 targets for 69 yards vs. Green Bay on Nov 25. With Puka Nacua done for the year and Davante Adams on IR, he is a starter in the Rams' thin receiver room.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was on injured reserve) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Pittman (foot) remained on IR on Sleeper as of Nov 25, though Mike McCarthy has said he is 'very confident' Pittman returns for Week 12 vs. Denver. Watch for an activation before kickoff.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson played about 48 snaps in his first game back from IR on Nov 22, catching 3 of 6 targets for 43 yards. Michael Pittman Jr.'s expected Week 12 return from IR would likely cut into his role.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) is still on IR as of Nov 25, and no designation to return had been reported. He is eligible for Week 12, and A.J. Brown (hamstring) being doubtful could open a bigger role once he is activated.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season with a neck/back fracture suffered Nov 8 vs. Seattle.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin is out for the 2026 season after tearing his patellar tendon on Oct 19. Rookie Antonio Williams has emerged as Washington's top receiver.

players.name: Ricky Pearsall
players.note: Pearsall (knee, IR) is listed as out for the season in Week 12 injury roundups as of Nov 24.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua (MCL surgery, IR) faces a four-to-five-month recovery, and Sean McVay said the Rams should plan without him. He is also serving a three-game suspension.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Harrison (hamstring strain) is listed questionable for Week 12 on Sleeper as of Nov 25 after missing Week 11. Tank Dell would see more work if he sits.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: With Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) questionable for Week 12 as of Nov 25 after missing Week 11, Dell is in line for extra targets if Harrison sits.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles tendinitis) is listed questionable for Week 12 as of Nov 25 after a 6-109-1 return on just 23 snaps on Nov 22.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: With Mike Evans back on Nov 22, Allen was held to 3 catches for 38 yards on 4 targets. His fill-in role shrinks if Evans (questionable, Achilles) plays in Week 12.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Cooper (ankle) is listed questionable for Week 12 as of Nov 25 after missing the Jets' Nov 22 game. It is his third ankle injury this year.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) is listed questionable for Week 12 as of Nov 25 after missing Weeks 9-11.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Diggs is listed questionable for Week 12 (personal) as of Nov 25. Rookie Antonio Williams (9-122 on Nov 23) has overtaken him as Washington's lead receiver.

players.name: Tetairoa McMillan
players.note: McMillan (foot soreness) is listed questionable for Week 12 on Sleeper as of Nov 25.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Flowers (ankle) is listed questionable for Week 12 on Sleeper as of Nov 25.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey returned from a back injury on Nov 22 in a full-time role (5-37-2 on 8 targets). Justin Herbert's concussion status clouds the Week 12 outlook vs. New England.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: With McConkey back full-time on Nov 22, Harris fell to 2 catches for 28 yards on 2 targets. Justin Herbert is also in the concussion protocol.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: With DeVonta Smith back on Nov 22, Lemon managed 1 catch for 3 yards on 3 targets, ending his fill-in WR1 volume heading into Thanksgiving at Dallas.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.note: With Jaylen Waddle back on Nov 22, Bryant slipped to 3 catches for 32 yards on 4 targets.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (shoulder) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Washington drew 17 targets on Nov 22 (8-103), cementing his lead role in Jacksonville's injury-thinned receiver room.

players.name: Ted Hurst III
players.note: Hurst caught 5 of 7 targets for 56 yards and two TDs on Nov 22, out-targeting Emeka Egbuka, and Tampa Bay's receiver pecking order looks wide open.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson had 1 catch for 6 yards on 36 snaps on Nov 22, and Kellen Moore blamed personnel sequencing for his limited snaps.

players.name: Colston Loveland
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (knee) as of 11:01 AM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: LaPorta (ankle) was upgraded from limited to a full practice on Tuesday, Nov 24 (an estimate from a walkthrough). He looks on track to play against the Bears on Thanksgiving.

players.name: Emanuel Wilson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Sleeper no longer lists him questionable as of Nov 25. NBC Sports noted on Nov 24 that he has been the WR67 in fantasy points per game since Week 3 and faces the toughest remaining schedule among receivers.

players.name: Jalen Milroe
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (illness) as of 12:20 AM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: He was a healthy scratch on Nov 22, his second straight coach's-decision inactive. He has no clear path to playing time in Baltimore without an injury.

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 12:20 AM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Drew Allar
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Taylen Green
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Sleeper upgraded him from out to questionable (hamstring) as of Nov 25, after he missed four straight games. That points to a possible return in Week 12 vs. New England, but the week's practice reports will decide it.

players.name: Skyler Bell
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Jack Strand
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (neck) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: He was left off Buffalo's first Week 12 injury report (week of Nov 24), so his knee/leg issue no longer looks like a concern. That follows 8 catches for 91 yards and a TD in Week 11.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (shoulder) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Rashod Bateman
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (knee) as of 3:37 PM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Sleeper has dropped his questionable (head) tag as of Nov 25, after reports said he cleared a concussion check during Atlanta's Week 11 bye. He looks on track for Week 12 at Minnesota.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Dalton Schultz
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (illness) as of 6:11 PM PT Nov 26.
